name: animated-input-otp
title: Animated Input OTP
description: One-time code boxes that fill, shake and confirm.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette. Any theme but Default also tints the active box, the gliding ring and the caret.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: allowedCharacters
props.label: Allowed characters
props.description: Which characters the boxes accept; anything else is ignored as you type or paste.

props.name: glideRing
props.label: Glide ring
props.description: One ring that slides from box to box as you type or move with the arrow keys. When off, each box just lights up on its own.

props.name: charAnimation
props.label: Character in
props.description: How each character appears in its box.

props.name: pasteStagger
props.label: Paste stagger
props.description: Delay between characters when a whole code is pasted, in seconds. Needs Character in set to anything but None.

props.name: shakeOnError
props.label: Shake on error
props.description: Shakes the boxes when the code is wrong or a blocked character is entered.

props.name: successWave
props.label: Success wave
props.description: A wave of the theme's success colour runs across the boxes when the code is right.

props.name: boxSize
props.label: Box size
props.description: Size of each box, on Tailwind's spacing scale.

props.name: joined
props.label: Joined boxes
props.description: Joins the boxes into one bar with shared borders.

props.name: rounded
props.label: Roundness
props.description: Corner radius of the boxes. With Joined boxes on, only the outer corners round.
